editorial: This report includes the trends that stood out today for the first time, without repeating what we have shared in recent days.

items.title: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
items.summary: Using the Claude Code infrastructure, ai-job-search offers a framework that automates the job search process. The tool analyzes the user profile and performs tasks such as resume editing, cover letter writing and interview preparation with the support of artificial intelligence.

items.title: AhmadIbrahiim/Website-downloader
items.summary: Website-downloader, developed by AhmadIbrahiim, allows downloading all source codes and assets of a website to the local computer using Node.js. The tool is used to archive the entire site, including JavaScript files, style sheets, and images.

items.title: iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI
items.summary: OfficeCLI offers an open source office suite that allows AI agents to directly read, edit and automate Word, Excel and PowerPoint files. Developed with C#, this tool allows operations to be performed via a single binary file without the need for any office software installation.

items.title: kyutai-labs/pocket-tts
items.summary: Developed by Kyutai Labs, Pocket-TTS is a lightweight text-to-speech model that runs only on the central processing unit (CPU) without the need for a graphics processing unit. Thanks to its low resource consumption, it offers fast and efficient sound synthesis on devices with hardware restrictions.

items.title: StreetComplete: Fixing OpenStreetMap, one tiny quest at a time
items.summary: StreetComplete is a mobile application that allows users to update OpenStreetMap data by answering simple questions. It aims to complete the missing information on the map by encouraging volunteer contributions through gamification.

items.title: Chat Control 1.0 and 2.0 Explained
items.summary: Chat control regulations discussed within the European Union aim to impose an obligation to scan content on end-to-end encrypted messaging platforms. These legislative initiatives are redefining digital privacy and data security standards to combat child exploitation.

items.title: Every new car sold in the European Union must include a driver monitoring camera
items.summary: All new vehicles sold throughout the European Union are required to have a driver monitoring camera that detects driver distraction. This system aims to reduce the risk of accidents through safety alerts by analyzing driver behavior.

items.title: 30papers.com – Ilya's 30 essential ML papers, in a beginner friendly format
items.summary: The 30papers.com platform offers 30 basic machine learning articles recommended by artificial intelligence researcher Ilya Sutskever in an accessible format for beginners. The project aims to facilitate learning basic concepts in the field of machine learning by simplifying complex academic content.

items.title: Local, CPU-Friendly, High-Quality TTS (Text-to-Speech) with Kokoro
items.summary: Kokoro is a model that runs on low processor power and offers high-quality text-to-speech capability on local devices. Thanks to its lightweight architecture, it allows fast and natural voice synthesis operations to be performed without the need for an internet connection.
